finalText: Migration complete. All 12 remaining `db.query` call sites in `packages/` (session, cohort, returnService, shipment, refund, couponService, macroAdmin, sla, variantAdmin, supplier, teamService, apiKeyAdmin) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` was left untouched (vendored code) and `cache.query` calls were left alone (unrelated API). `verify.js` passes.
